marketing_description: The Milwaukee 12V M12 1/4 in Square Drive Ratchet features a POWERSTATE brushless motor and REDLINK PLUS intelligence to deliver up to 40 ft-lbs of torque with a speed rating of 0 to 250 RPM. Designed with an overall length of 11-1/4 in, it incorporates a low profile head design, a variable speed metal trigger, and a premium rubber overmold. This tool operates on an M12 battery type.
